mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM residence WHERE person_id=#{personId} AND end_date IS NULL) residence_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ownership WHERE person_id=#{personId} AND end_date IS NULL) property_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_bill_financial_summary v WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM residence r WHERE r.person_id=#{personId} AND r.property_unit_id=v.property_unit_id AND r.end_date IS NULL) AND v.outstanding_amount>0) outstanding_bill_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_recipient WHERE person_id=#{personId} AND read_at IS NULL) unread_notification_count

SELECT r.residence_id,r.property_unit_id,CONCAT(c.community_name,' · ',b.building_no,'号楼 · ',COALESCE(bu.unit_name,CONCAT(bu.unit_no,'单元')),' · ',pu.property_no) full_location,pu.occupancy_status,r.residence_role,r.start_date,r.expected_end_date FROM residence r JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id=r.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id=pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id=b.community_id WHERE r.person_id=#{personId} AND r.end_date IS NULL ORDER BY r.start_date DESC

SELECT pu.property_unit_id,CONCAT(c.community_name,' · ',b.building_no,'号楼 · ',COALESCE(bu.unit_name,CONCAT(bu.unit_no,'单元')),' · ',pu.property_no) full_location,pu.gross_area,pu.occupancy_status FROM ownership o JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id=o.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id=pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id=b.community_id WHERE o.person_id=#{personId} AND o.end_date IS NULL ORDER BY c.community_name,b.building_no,pu.property_no

SELECT v.bill_id,v.bill_no,CONCAT(c.community_name,' · ',b.building_no,'号楼 · ',pu.property_no) full_location,v.billing_year,v.billing_month,v.receivable_amount,v.outstanding_amount,v.due_date,v.status FROM v_bill_financial_summary v JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id=v.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id=pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id=b.community_id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM residence r WHERE r.person_id=#{personId} AND r.property_unit_id=v.property_unit_id AND r.end_date IS NULL) ORDER BY v.billing_year DESC,v.billing_month DESC,v.bill_id DESC

SELECT n.notification_id,n.title,n.category,n.sent_at,nr.read_at FROM notification_recipient nr JOIN notification n ON n.notification_id=nr.notification_id WHERE nr.person_id=#{personId} ORDER BY n.sent_at DESC,n.notification_id DESC
WHERE ri.reporter_person_id=#{personId} ORDER BY ri.created_at DESC
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM residence WHERE person_id=#{personId} AND property_unit_id=#{propertyUnitId} AND end_date IS NULL)
mapper.sql: SELECT ri.resident_incident_id,ri.property_unit_id,CONCAT(c.community_name,' · ',b.building_no,'号楼 · ',pu.property_no) full_location,ri.category,ri.description,ri.status,ri.created_at,ri.resolved_at FROM resident_incident ri JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id=ri.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id=pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id=b.community_id
mapper.select: WHERE 1=1 AND b.community_id IN #{id} AND 1=0 ORDER BY FIELD(ri.status,'OPEN','PROCESSING','RESOLVED'),ri.created_at DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT property_unit_id FROM resident_incident WHERE resident_incident_id=#{incidentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE resident_incident SET status=#{status},handled_by_account_id=#{accountId},resolved_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='RESOLVED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE NULL END WHERE resident_incident_id=#{incidentId} AND status<>'RESOLVED'
